$comment: The dev harness, on the same Mac mini as production under its own account.
Everything that could collide with production is different here: the label
prefix, every port, the Slack app behind /services/slack, and the account
the services run as. Dev runs system-domain jobs like production does, so
the deploy exercises production's path, but its manifests live in its own
home rather than in the root-owned /Library/LaunchDaemons, and its sudo
rights cover only launchctl on com.puffle.dev labels. Per-user launchd
domains are supported too, and are the right shape for a host whose
account has a login session; this one is driven over ssh and has none.
Dev is where a deploy change is proven before prod.
Email and phone are absent: dev has no separate mailbox or phone number,
and pointing them at production's would answer real people.
Dev has no GitHub credential, so its origin is a local bare mirror and
mirrorUpstream names where the deployer fast-forwards that mirror from
before each poll: production's checkout, which tracks merged main.
name: dev
